topic: How does the 41% efficiency of the proposed antenna impact link budget calculations for GEO-LEO satellite links?
consensus_response: The 41% antenna efficiency reduces EIRP, increasing noise temperature and decreasing SNR, compromising link closure. Beamforming techniques can enhance gain, but signal depolarization due to ionospheric effects may impact polarization ratio. Atmospheric attenuation and scintillation further degrade signal quality, necessitating adaptive modulation and coding techniques.
reference_context: SatCom systems require careful link budget analysis considering antenna efficiency, noise temperatures, and propagation effects to ensure reliable transmission.
